en.io: Inputs are the claude-osint repository, optional --no-net mode, sample secret text, directories to scan, and HackerOne query options. Outputs include PASS/FAIL status, JSONL secret findings, frontmatter validation results, synchronization status, and disclosed-report data.
en.boundary: The package has no GUI or server. The live HackerOne check is described as non-fatal and relies on an undocumented endpoint. The sync check may skip missing source material and still exit successfully. Example tokens in documentation can produce expected scanner findings.
dependencies: Repository scripts including smoke.sh, secret_scan.py, h1_reference.py, and sync-skill-content.sh
Outbound HTTPS to hackerone.com for the optional live check
Optional markdownlint-cli2 and shellcheck for fuller CI parity
scenarios: Run the repository's full or offline smoke test.
Validate OSINT skill frontmatter fields and trigger counts.
Test the secret scanner against stdin or repository content.
Exercise the HackerOne disclosed-report helper when network access is available.

zh.io: 输入包括 claude-osint 仓库、可选 --no-net 模式、示例密钥文本、待扫描目录和 HackerOne 查询参数。输出包括 PASS/FAIL 状态、JSONL 密钥发现、前置元数据验证结果、同步检查状态和披露报告数据。
zh.boundary: 该包没有 GUI 或服务器。HackerOne 在线检查依赖未公开接口，并被描述为非致命检查。同步脚本可能在源目录缺失时跳过并仍返回成功。文档中的示例令牌会产生预期的扫描结果。
dependencies: 用于前置元数据验证的 PyYAML
可选在线检查需要访问 hackerone.com
用于更完整复现 CI 的可选 markdownlint-cli2 和 shellcheck
scenarios: 运行完整或离线模式的仓库冒烟测试。
验证 OSINT 技能前置元数据字段和触发词数量。
使用标准输入或仓库内容测试密钥扫描器。
网络可用时测试 HackerOne 已披露报告辅助工具。
